page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number top left, running head top centre. Marginal note "Lac" in the left margin beside the line "nemo". Catchword "mo" at right below the last line. Show-through from the reverse side at the bottom left, not transcribed.

main_text.l: in Peloponnefum duxerat, multos Peloponnesi populos sibi adjunxerat, multa hostium oppida & loca ceperat: deinde cum videret imperii sui tempus ad finem decurrere, & asperrimum brumæ frigus exercitum premere, collegasque reliquos domum rediturire, ut locum legi & successoribus darent, simul vero cerneret calentia in se sociorum Peloponnensium studia, nec imperitiam ac socordiam successorum suorum ignoraret, prævideretque difcessium suum ab exercitu ac sociis, & imperium depositum incremento rerum patriæ plurimum obfuturum, persuaso primum Pelopidâ, dein reliquis collegis etiam retentis, omni culpa facti in se recepta, mediam Laconiam pervadens, Eurotamque fl. transgressus ad ipsam urbem Spartam cum infestis copiis accessit, eaque ingenti formidine consternata, cum pugnandi causa prodiret ne-mo, in Messeniam transfiit, & regionis ejus incolis Lacedæmoniorum servis ad pileum vocatis, & Messeniis aliis extoribus hinc inde accersitis, quòd nosset id incidendis Lacedæmoniorum hostium nervis quàm maximè esse, novam iis urbem idoneo loco ad Ithomen montem condidit, firmissimis cinctam moenibus, opusque festinato labore, sum-mo-

page.notes: The left margin note reads "Lac" with a doubtful final letter; it sits beside "nemo" and is marked [?]. The last word of the page is split "fum-" at the line end; the catchword "mo" is taken as the start of the next page. The bottom-left garbled marks ("coioc", "coloo tuy cc") are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. The line ending "sum-mo" was printed as "fum-" across the line end; the text above reads "sum-" with the catchword completing it, so the printed form has been kept as "sum-mo" and should be checked against the scan. Spelling "rediturire" and "difcessium" kept as printed.
